messages:
Omar: quick heads-up — after the quant4b bring-up eval, our sample overlap with the baseline holdout dropped to ~57%. That seems high for sampling drift. I think our repooling step removed a bunch of anchors. Can someone take a quick look? link: https://redwood.internal/drive/quant4b-sampling

Lina: do you have the sampling SQL or script? might be something with the random seed or dedupe pass ordering.

Omar: here's the sampling snippet I used (from the bringup job):
```sql
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY instr_hash ORDER BY last_seen DESC) as rn
  FROM public.promptbank
  WHERE model_tag = 'raf-quant4b'
)
SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY random() LIMIT 5000;
```
I think the `instr_hash` dedupe is the culprit — we changed tokenization slightly for the quantized model importer.

Matt: fwiw the embedding-fingerprint dedupe also behaves differently when the tokenizer mapping shifts. We should re-embed with the exact tokenizer used in serving to avoid hash collisions. Suggest: `python tools/embed_and_cluster.py --model raf-quant4b --threshold 0.82 --tokenizer-vocab v2`.

Anya: relabel impact: of the 5k samples, ~120 are in the golden set. If we repool we either need to preserve golden anchors or schedule a relabel pass for those 120. Labeling capacity is tight this week.

Jie: I can coordinate labelers. If Lina triggers a repool that touches golden, I'll open a priority queue and we can get a small sprint. tag the examples with `golden:staged` so ops knows not to auto-promote.

labeler-bot: Queue created: "quant4b-golden-relabel" (priority: high). 3 slots reserved. Link: https://redwood.internal/labeler/queues/quant4b-golden-relabel

Lina: I'll take ownership of the repool script and run a dry pass with dedupe turned off to estimate churn. Planning to run at 1715560200 and post a diff.

Matt: please include stratified counts by intent_category and token_length buckets (0-50,51-150,150+). We saw earlier that short prompts were over/under-represented after sampling.

Jie: also please dump any suspicious clusters — we had a few paraphrase clusters where the embedding threshold was masking near-duplicates. I'll ask labelers to spot-check those.

Omar: agreement: freeze golden promotion until relabel completes. @Lina let us know when dry-run done. thanks all :thumbsup:

Anya: if relabel exceeds 48h, we fallback to baseline (non-quant) model in the canary to avoid customer regressions.

Lina: acknowledged — will post results and a concise action list after the dry run.

Matt: small note — when you run the dry pass, log `instr_hash` versions and tokenizer commit hash so we can audit churn later.

Omar: perfect. tagging this thread with `action:repool` and `owner:@Lina`.
